evidence.description: Pin-mux configuration function (600 bytes) manipulates GPBFUN @ 0xB0000084 with read-modify-write pattern. Parameters: r0=port, r1=pin, r2=function.
Systematic analysis of all 12 pin-mux callers found only 3 Port B configurations: GPB[0] Function 2 @ 0x00031e4c and 0x00031ea4, GPB[6] Function 5 @ 0x0005c210. Zero configurations for GPB[2-5].
N32903K5DN LQFP-128 pinout shows Pin 128=GPB[2] (GPIO/I2S_MCLK/SDCLK1), Pin 127=GPB[3] (GPIO/I2S_BCLK/SDCMD1), Pin 126=GPB[4] (GPIO/I2S_WS/SDDAT1[3]), Pin 125=GPB[5] (GPIO/I2S_DOUT/SDDAT1[2])
Alternative function search for I2S_BA @ 0xB1001000, SPI, I2C, UART, PWM controllers yielded 0 hits, confirming no alternative function usage of GPB[2-5]
